name: Professor Torus Tinker and his Titillating Tales
source:
Travel the universe with Professor Torus Tinker, Kinkster Fixer.

Join the crew of this mysterious yet handsome alien and visit alien worlds, meet their men, and fix whatever's clogging their pipes. You'll choose from multiple paths, deciding who to work with, who to spend time with, and who to get naked with.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3383080/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
与Kinkster Fixer的Torus Tinker教授一起遨游宇宙。

加入这个神秘而英俊的外星人的船员队伍，参观外星世界，会见他们的手下，并修复管道堵塞的问题。你将从多种路径中进行选择，决定与谁一起工作、与谁共度时光以及与谁裸体。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3383080/]Steam[/url]]
